name: emonet-voice-bench
description: emonet-voice-bench evaluates models on voice/audio-based emotion and related paralinguistic recognition tasks using recorded speech. It measures how well systems classify emotional states, speaker affect, or other vocal attributes from audio signals and supports benchmarking models for robust speech-emotion understanding. The benchmark emphasizes performance across standard audio splits and commonly used emotion labels.
reputation: Relatively low adoption / community visibility compared to large speech benchmarks; useful for niche emotion-recognition experiments.
